incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired: GPU-MEM-CRITICAL for pool rwd-ena-gpu-7 (region=us-east-1)
pagerduty: Alert: GPU memory pressure exceeded threshold (75% sustained). Service: inference-runtime. Incident key: PD-14287.
Maya R: acked the pager. i'm looking. not seeing obvious pod restarts yet but latency spiking on ded-serve-3.
Cheng L: seeing repeated CUDA_ERROR_OUT_OF_MEMORY and a bunch of mmap failures in the kernel logs: `cuda: mmap failed: -12` on node rwd-gpu-7-12. dumping last 200 lines.
Cheng L: logs:
```
2026-03-15T14:34:21Z model_server[pid=2189]: runtime error: CUDA_ERROR_OUT_OF_MEMORY
2026-03-15T14:34:22Z kernel: failed to mmap gpu slab: out of memory
2026-03-15T14:34:23Z inferer: kv-cache eviction spike +70% in 30s
```
Maya R: ok, looks like a fragmentation spike rather than simple alloc growth. kv-cache eviction jitter correlates.
Leo (devops): are customers impacted? any 5xxs?
Sasha K: customer-metrics shows error-rate up for model=redwood-3b-quant by ~4.2% and p99 latency doubled for a small subset of routes (chat-v1). cs-bot: open ticket created for impacted customers (CS-8921).
Maya R: mitigation plan: 1) temporarily scale pool rwd-ena-gpu-7 by +2 nodes, 2) force fallback to quantized-2g model for non-SLA tenants, 3) trigger kv-cache aggressive eviction config. doing step 1 now.
Leo (devops): scaling command:
```
# k8s autoscaler: scale node group
aws eks update-nodegroup-config --cluster-name rwd-prod --nodegroup-name g4dn-pool-7 --scaling-config minSize=3,maxSize=10,desiredSize=6
```
Leo (devops): kicked off, ETA ~120s.
Cheng L: while nodes come up, we can patch runtime to prefer smaller allocator footprint. applying hotpatch to runtime config: `runtime.alloc.policy=fragmentation-mitigate`
Maya R: patched and toggled `kv_cache.eviction_threshold=0.6` (was 0.8). will monitor.
pagerduty: Escalation: no ack from secondary oncall within 90s; escalating to oncall-lead.
Maya R: noted. @Sasha K can you surface this in CS? any paying accounts in the impacted shard?
Sasha K: yes, two mid-market customers hitting chat-v1 in us-east. CS already sending a brief.
Cheng L: additional logs show repeated `cuda: driver OOM, attempt purge failed` and a sequence of small allocations causing fragmentation. attaching pmap snapshot.
Maya R: temp mitigation success? p99 latency dropping back ~30% but still above baseline. kv-cache evictions stabilized after change.
Leo (devops): new nodes joined, kube pods draining and rebalancing. node rwd-gpu-7-13 added.
pagerduty: PD-14287 acknowledged by Maya R.
Sasha K: Customer impact note: intermittent 5xxs for chat-v1 between 14:33-14:45 UTC; escalated to account owners.
Maya R: next steps: 1) keep scaled nodes for 2 hours, 2) schedule a follow-up to test allocator patch in staging, 3) open a deeper-ticket for runtime fragmentation analysis. I'll hand off to Cheng for long-term analysis.
Cheng L: on it. creating issue: RWD-OPS-3564 with heap dumps and pmap. plan: reproduce with synthetic KV-cache churn, test slab allocator knob and upstream driver.
Leo (devops): any rollback needed?
Maya R: no rollback. mitigation looks good. leaving autoscaler increased for safety.
Sasha K: CS update sent, customers acknowledged and asked for postmortem.
Maya R: handing off to Cheng for post-incident followup. I'm on-call for another 18 minutes if anything else fires. :thumbsup:
Cheng L: taking ownership for analysis and timeline. will coordinate with runtime/research.
incident-bot: Thread closed by Maya R at 2026-03-15T14:50:20Z (manual close).
